answer: Reward here is a non-transferable bond tied to one scarce hardware anchor, and standing only accretes when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign audited work-receipts. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single funding root, so its endorsements drain back through hidden channels like water through KARST, never pooling into real trust; honest standing hardens slowly layer by layer like a CRYSTAL, while a cloned identity stays a hollow RELIC. The farm pays to age a distinct cross-cluster anchor per head (linear), honest climbs once.
